question: Does recent-month reversal on existing fixed CN300 persist after one skipped month, by exchange, and does loser selection help versus all eligible and low-volatility selection?
paper: Shi Jiang Zhou 2015 doi10.1371/journal.pone.0137892; local-method replication not original population or execution

strategy_sources.path: /Users/yongbiaoli/Desktop/lei signal doc/LEI 技术交易体系.md

feature_definition: reuse research.selection.short_reversal.month_return@1.0.0; negative recent month return is higher reversal; existing momentum/vol60 formulas unchanged
eligible: reuse monthly_features qualification excluding ONLY not_green and green_unknown reasons; 12 full calendar months prices, clean adjustment chain, decision traded non-ST positive volume, momentum and vol60 available; not future-label-dependent
groups: separate sh/sz; n>=30 eligible per exchange-month; k=ceil(n/10); stable sort ties by code; loser lowest hot, winner highest hot, lowvol lowest vol60, all equal weight; no green/trend filter
outcomes: same signal selections frozen at T. lag0 first trading day T+1 open to first trading day T+2 open. lag1 first day T+2 open to first T+3 open. reuse adjusted_future_outcome; no changing eligibility with future status; unknown weight kept, not filled or reweighted. All scheduled future months must be complete in source; last exit January2026 first day.
comparison: per exchange/lag same-month candidate-minus-all/winner/lowvol complete paired quote results; additionally decay lag0-minus-lag1 on common complete loser-winner months. Report full 131 axis and unknown weight in every portfolio. No complete-only zero replacement.
metrics: mean individual entry-to-subsequent-close low (not portfolio drawdown)
future top-decile and >=20% winners retained; known outcome denominator
gross target drift-adjusted rebalance turnover and 0.25% per side approximation, both common-sample gross/net; final liquidation
four contribution pieces versus all/lowvol: added gains/losses, avoided losses/foregone gains
raw rank IC, partial ranked association controlling momentum and vol60; no dummy groups and not tradable alpha

inference.method: HAC/Bartlett lag6 keeping missing calendar slots; 95% normal approximation, not independent new evidence

execution_sensitivity: upward one-price entry/downward one-price exit -> unknown, from existing outcome helper; compare using original fixed selections
mechanism_boundary: lag decay consistent with temporary effects but cannot identify forced selling vs bad news; size/industry/ownership/borrow/real fills unavailable
stop: No parameter or universe optimization; report negative/mixed; errors repair retained. Exact full-market paper reproduction blocked by original period/universe/totalreturns; no production or trading.
